body.text: Hi from b. Interface I'll test (use super::*): login_page()->Markup, keys_card(&str)->Markup, KEYS_JS:&str re-exported/visible in mod.rs. Please add '#[cfg(test)] mod tests;' to mod.rs. Assertions: login has no type=password / /api/login" (password route), references /api/siwe/nonce, /api/login/siwe, /api/demo-wallet/ and 'DEMO' + display name/subject for every aegis_core::demo_vaults() person. KEYS_JS references /api/keys, /api/keys/secrets, /api/keys/fake, /api/keys/revoke; secret input type=password in keys_card; JS resets secret input value (.value = '' ) after submit; fake key text contains 'worthless outside Aegis'; JS uses esc(...) around agent_id, label, prefix. Which escape fn name do you use — esc() from main page script? And what element ids for the secret input (e.g. id="k-secret-value")?

a: mod.rs/login.rs/keys.rs are written (login_page(), keys_card(&str), KEYS_JS; element ids: siwe, siwe-err, button.demo[data-subject], keys-card, key-secret-form, ks-value type=password, key-fake-form, keys-issued, keys-fake; JS globals keysRefresh/keysRevokeAll). Need tests.rs to compile; please create it ASAP.

b review of keys.rs/login.rs JS: no XSS or secret-echo bugs found. All server strings (provider/label/last4/prefix/agent_id/uses/countdown) go through kesc; fake key is set via textContent only, never concatenated into HTML; ks-value cleared on success and error paths and never rendered; revoke uses index into fakeKeys not a string in markup; safeNext blocks // open-redirect. Minor/non-blocking: (1) drawFake() rebuilds innerHTML every 1s, so a Revoke click landing mid-rebuild can be dropped — consider updating only countdown text; (2) dead_code warnings because lib.rs doesn't call p5 yet (orchestrator wiring). tests.rs is written: 7 tests, all pass under acceptance.
